name: Nami
title: the Tidecaller

passive.name: Surging Tides

description.normalized: Allied champions touched by Nami's abilities gain 65 (+20% AP) Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds.

passive.rawParsedText: Allied champions touched by Nami's abilities gain 65 (+20% AP) Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds.

q.name: Aqua Prison

description.normalized: Fires a bubble, dealing 75 / 145 / 215 / 285 (+50% AP) magic damage and knocking up for 1.5 seconds.

q.rawParsedText: Fires a bubble, dealing 75 / 145 / 215 / 285 (+50% AP) magic damage and knocking up for 1.5 seconds.

w.name: Ebb and Flow

description.normalized: Launches a stream that bounces 3 times between allied and enemy champions, healing allies for 55 / 85 / 115 / 145 (+30% AP) and dealing 65 / 120 / 175 / 230 (+50% AP) magic damage to enemies. Can hit each target once. Healing and damage values are modified by -15% (+7.5% AP) each bounce.

w.rawParsedText:
Launches a stream that bounces 3 times between allied and enemy champions, healing allies for 55 / 85 / 115 / 145 (+30% AP) and dealing 65 / 120 / 175 / 230 (+50% AP) magic damage to enemies.

Can hit each target once. Healing and damage values are modified by -15% (+7.5% AP) each bounce.

e.name: Tidecaller's Blessing

description.normalized: Empowers an allied champion's next 3 attacks for 6 seconds to deal an additional 25 / 45 / 65 / 85 (+20% AP) magic damage and slow by 15% / 20% / 25% / 30% (+0.05% AP) for 1 second.

e.rawParsedText: Empowers an allied champion's next 3 attacks for 6 seconds to deal an additional 25 / 45 / 65 / 85 (+20% AP) magic damage and slow by 15% / 20% / 25% / 30% (+0.05% AP) for 1 second.

r.name: Tidal Wave

description.normalized: Sends a wave, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+60% AP) magic damage, knocking up for 0.5 seconds and slowing by 50% / 60% / 70%. Slow lasts for 2 - 4 seconds, increasing with how far the wave travels. Allies touched gain double the effect from Surging Tides.

r.rawParsedText:
Sends a wave, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+60% AP) magic damage, knocking up for 0.5 seconds and slowing by 50% / 60% / 70%.

Slow lasts for 2 - 4 seconds, increasing with how far the wave travels.

Allies touched gain double the effect from Surging Tides.
